verdict.rationale: Salesforce has an official MCP server, published APIs and a CLI with data commands, plus lead management, built-in lead routing, and agents that qualify inbound leads. Together these imply an agent could create a lead and route it to an owner. But nothing shows the end-to-end flow through the API or MCP server: no documented lead-create call, no company-data enrichment, and no programmatic owner assignment. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP lead creation, firmographic/company data enrichment capability, API-driven owner assignment, hands-on or independent corroboration of the end-to-end agent workflow.
